about: Every key letter_create.py reads from a letter's data file. The builder stops on a key that is not here, and on a value of another shape (skills/_shared/spec_guard.py). A fact with no field of its own goes in the body, or, for the sender's own particulars, in sender.further.

hints.notes: a letter has no notes: what the letter says goes in "body", one string a paragraph
hints.postscript: write a postscript as the last paragraph of "body"
hints.sender.contact: the person to reach goes in the top-level "contact" (name, phone, email), printed in the information block
hints.recipient.email: an e-mail address is not part of a postal address; if the letter must show it, write it in "body"
hints.recipient.phone: a phone number is not part of a postal address; if the letter must show it, write it in "body"
hints.sender.street2: the sender's own address prints as street, postcode and city: write a second address line into "sender.street", after a comma
hints.sender.building: the sender's own address prints as street, postcode and city: write a second address line into "sender.street", after a comma
hints.sender.locality: the sender's own address prints as street, postcode and city: write a second address line into "sender.street", after a comma
hints.sender.county: the sender's own address prints as street, postcode and city: write a second address line into "sender.street", after a comma
hints.signatory.title: the signatory's role or job title is "signatory.role"
hints.reference: a reference goes in "references", a list: {"kind": "ours", "value": "KL-114"} or {"label": "Your letter of", "value": "2026-10-02"}
hints.our_reference: a reference goes in "references", a list: {"kind": "ours", "value": "KL-114"}
hints.your_reference: a reference goes in "references", a list: {"kind": "yours", "value": "..."}
hints.reference_ours: a reference goes in "references", a list: {"kind": "ours", "value": "KL-114"}
hints.reference_their: a reference goes in "references", a list: {"kind": "yours", "value": "..."}
hints.recipient.company: the recipient's company is "recipient.name"; a person there goes in "recipient.attention"
hints.recipient.contact: a person at the recipient goes in "recipient.attention"
